changes: Added BEC-PRIME/routes/auth.js as the canonical persistent email/password account router.
Added BEC-PRIME/lib/authRuntimePreload.js so production start.js uses the new auth router without breaking the legacy Dreamiez route module.
Updated BEC-PRIME/package.json to load the auth runtime preload in production and smoke startup.
Updated BEC-PRIME/scripts/smoke-dreamiez.js with anonymous, register, logout, login, invalid-login and restart-persistence checks.
security: Passwords use Node scrypt with per-user random salts.
Session cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax.
Anonymous /api/account/me now returns authenticated=false instead of creating an anonymous account.
required_runtime_result: smoke_test=PASS; account_created=true; anonymous_blocked=true; login=true; logout=true; password_hashed=true; persistence_across_restart=true
